description: This file defines application configuration settings for the backend, including environment-based configuration loading, environment variable parsing, and database URL construction. It includes a dataclass for settings and utility functions for environment variable extraction.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: Immutable dataclass that encapsulates all application configuration settings loaded from environment variables.

methods.name: List[str] _split_csv(value: str)
methods.description: Utility function that splits a comma-separated string into a list of trimmed strings.

methods.name: str _build_database_url_from_postgres_env()
methods.description: Constructs a PostgreSQL connection URL from environment variables.

methods.name: Settings get_settings()
methods.description: Main function to load and assemble all application settings from environment variables.
